'''Narrik''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of [[Veneb Drassk's clan]]. He was present during the [[Skirmish on Taris|confrontation]] between [[Veneb Drassk]] and [[Qyzen Fess]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], and joined the rest of his clan in convincing Fess to assume leadership of the clan and teach them about the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] after Drassk's [[Death/Legends|death]].
